نستبي (form VIII)
# نَسْتَبِي (nastabī) /nas.ta.biː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبَى (istabā)
# نَسْتَبِيَ (nastabiya) /nas.ta.bi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبَى (istabā)
